body.statement: Given a rational matrix \(D\), rational vectors \(d,p\), and their binary encoding, linear-program feasibility and the finite optimum of \(p^{\mathsf T}x\) over \(\{x:Dx\le d\}\) can be computed exactly in a number of bit operations polynomial in the encoding length; in the nonempty bounded case the computation returns a rational optimal point.

source.verbatim_statement: Построены точные алгоритмы линейного программирования, трудоемкость которых ограничена полиномом от длины двоичной записи задачи.

attestation.note: Direct transcription of the Russian abstract on page 51 of the primary MathNet full-text scan, retrieved 2026-09-15. English: exact linear-programming algorithms are constructed whose complexity is polynomial in the binary input length.
